class.name: SaveGame
class.description: Written and read by [ProjectStatics]. Every script variable is serialized to JSON by default; override [code]_to_json[/code] and [code]_from_json[/code] for a custom format.

method.name: _from_json
method.description: Override to read back what [method _to_json] wrote. Return an [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. A save written by an older build is the normal case rather than the exception, so branch on a version you put in the payload yourself.

method.name: _to_json
method.description: Override to serialize by hand instead of by reflection. Returning from this replaces the default entirely, so it is also how you keep a property out of the file.

method.name: from_json
method.description: Reads [param data] back, assigning each key to the property of that name. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_DATA] if [param data] is not a [Dictionary].

method.name: to_json
method.description: Serializes to a JSON string. Without an override this writes [b]every script variable[/b], not only the [code]@export[/code]ed ones - a plain GDScript member carries no storage flag, and requiring one would serialize an empty object for every save class written in GDScript.
